scope: All four B02 acceptance criteria on the identified native virtual reference; not full Phase2/G2/installer/ISO/physical acceptance. Historical partial/failing artifacts retain their original scope.

criteria.criterion: Login and basic browser/files/terminal/editor/network/audio work in the reference guest using pinned owned packages.
criteria.observed: Normal GDM/PAM owner, real keyboard/tablet, browser input/navigation/Stop/TLS/offline/restart, Files/Trash, Terminal/UTF8/Git, Editor save/recovery, network controls/DHCP/DNS/HTTPS and non-silent virtual HDA/mute. Final Tecla viewer level navigation/close.

criteria.criterion: The desktop stays usable without keys, models, network or active agent/inference; optional network applications fail clearly.
criteria.observed: Normal native desktop and offline Editor operations with no installed Toddy agent, no desktop model acquisition/configuration prerequisite and no active agent/inference. Missing network failed clearly; native browser Stop/offline proof retained. Fresh fixture owner and desktop projection have no agent/model installation dependency; incidental build-source/prototype material is not a claim of a composed image.

criteria.criterion: Publish the minimal package manifest, resource measurements and optional-app packaging status; no unsupported package is advertised as working.
criteria.observed: 360observed native packages,308package retained-foundation/desktop projection with exact versions/source/legal records;52unselected integration packages explicitly await image-composition review. criteria.criterion: New browser/XML/network/privileged consumers have recorded security/ABI review and owned pinned dependencies; no silent frozen-foundation upgrade bypasses a failure.
criteria.observed: Owned pinned native closure. Explicit same-ESR browser security overlay instead of silent foundation upgrade; actual browser process sandbox/TLS/runtime checks. XML external-resource and native consumer checks; NM/polkit recovery; exact single FUSE helper privilege policy with actual different-UID/allow_other denial and cancellation/unmount recovery. Git source/full suite/native ownership and credential/state refusal.

smoke_rows.S01-B: Desktop budgets measured with methods/caches/reference profile and no unexplained miss; service/entry/search measurements remain their owning stories.
smoke_rows.S02: Normal login and actual keyboard/mouse/apps/network/virtual sound passed, using linked component evidence.
smoke_rows.S03: Desktop works without installing/configuring a Toddy agent or model for the fresh owner. No active inference/agent; offline use verified. Development integration root retains nonrequired build/prototype material; final B12 composition remains separate.

change_based_reuse: Retain unchanged qualified browser/files/network/audio/native package proofs. Later FUSE/kernel/portal changes got directly affected native boot/helper/appearance/request tests. Git got original/native CLI plus final ordinary Terminal proof. No unchanged foundation/compiler/libc/physical/provider/soak matrix repeated.
